title: mimirheim-helper-schema meta-schema
description: Structural sanity check applied to every *.schema.json file discovered by the config-editor (SPEC.md §2, §10 rule 3), both bundled and drop-in. Deliberately narrow: it confirms the document is shaped like a JSON Schema (properties/required/$defs carry the right JSON type) and, if a $schema dialect is declared, that it is the supported one. It does NOT enforce the x-mimirheim envelope's own required keys, the file name pattern, the reserved file name, or the category enum -- those are separate, individually actionable rejection rules (SPEC.md §10 rules 4-9) implemented directly in registry.py so each produces its own specific message naming the offending key.
